components.name: Primary Diagnose Button
components.description: Main execution CTA for submitting schema and query to PGlite WASM.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-primary"><svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="currentColor"><polygon points="5 3 19 12 5 21 5 3"/></svg>Diagnose Index</button>
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; background: linear-gradient(to right, #10b981, #14b8a6); color: #020617; font-weight: 600; font-size: 14px; padding: 10px 24px; border-radius: 12px; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: opacity 0.15s, transform 0.15s; font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { opacity: 0.95; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { background: #1e293b; color: #64748b; border: 1px solid #334155; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Secondary Reset Button
components.description: Quiet reset action to clear SQL editors.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-secondary"><svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M3 12a9 9 0 1 0 9-9 9.75 9.75 0 0 0-6.74 2.74L3 8"/><path d="M3 3v5h5"/></svg>Reset</button>
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; background: #0f172a; color: #94a3b8; border: 1px solid #1e293b; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; padding: 8px 14px; border-radius: 12px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s, color 0.15s; font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #1e293b; color: #e2e8f0; }

components.name: Migration Tab
components.description: Segmented tab item for switching between Postgres, Drizzle, and Prisma migration formats.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; padding: 4px; background: #0f172a; border: 1px solid #1e293b; border-radius: 8px; font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-tab { padding: 4px 12px; border-radius: 6px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; border: none; cursor: pointer; color: #94a3b8; background: transparent; transition: color 0.15s; } .ds-tab-active { background: #10b981; color: #020617; font-weight: 600; } .ds-tab:hover:not(.ds-tab-active) { color: #f1f5f9; }

components.name: Preset Selection Pill
components.description: 1-click golden preset button to load schema and query instantly.
components.css: .ds-preset-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 6px 14px; border-radius: 9999px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; border: 1px solid #1e293b; background: #0f172a; color: #94a3b8; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.15s; font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-preset-pill:hover { border-color: #334155; color: #f1f5f9; } .ds-preset-active { background: rgba(6, 78, 59, 0.4); border-color: rgba(5, 150, 105, 0.8); color: #6ee7b7; } .ds-indicator { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 9999px; background: #34d399; }

components.name: Severity Status Badge
components.description: Diagnostic outcome badge indicating critical bottleneck or optimal status.
components.css: .ds-severity-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 9999px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-sev-critical { background: rgba(76, 5, 25, 0.6); border: 1px solid rgba(190, 18, 60, 0.6); color: #fda4af; } .ds-sev-optimal { background: rgba(6, 78, 59, 0.6); border: 1px solid rgba(4, 120, 87, 0.6); color: #6ee7b7; }

narrative.overview:
IndexDoctor's interface is designed as an instrument-grade diagnostic cockpit for backend developers, database engineers, and tech leads. The visual tone is direct, mission-critical, and sober. The screen is treated as an active telemetry console: deep obsidian canvas (slate-950) with precision slate panels (slate-900) and crisp structural borders (slate-800).

The visual world strips away decorative flourishes to prioritize raw information density, execution plan readability, and unequivocal performance signals. Luminous signal colors—emerald (#10b981) for proven cost reductions and index-only scans, rose (#f43f5e) for critical sequential scan bottlenecks, and amber (#f59e0b) for ESR column orderings—act as precise instrument beacons on a dark radar.
keyCharacteristics: Pure flat architectural depth with zero simulated shadows; hierarchy is dictated by background luminosity steps and 1px stroke boundaries.
Refined and restrained component interactions where controls remain subordinate to SQL code and plan trees until actively engaged.
Monospace-first data presentation for all schemas, queries, cost metrics, and ORM migrations.
High-contrast, zero-bullshit information hierarchy adhering strictly to WCAG AA visibility.

rules.name: The Rarity of Emerald Rule
rules.body: Emerald is strictly an achievement color. It is never used for general decoration, background fills, or non-verified states. If emerald appears, PostgreSQL's optimizer has mathematically confirmed a cost improvement.

rules.name: The Semantic Signal Rule
rules.body: Rose, amber, and emerald are reserved exclusively for execution plan states (bottleneck -> warning -> improved). They are never applied arbitrarily to interface chrome.

rules.name: The Code Equality Rule
rules.body: All SQL schemas, queries, planner costs, execution nodes, and migration outputs must render in monospace font. Never format raw database strings or numerical costs in proportional body fonts.

rules.name: The Zero-Drop Shadow Rule
rules.body: Cards and panels never cast drop shadows onto the canvas. Visual separation is achieved strictly through 1px border contrast and step-wise background luminosity shifts.

rules.name: The Sticky Border Rule
rules.body: Fixed elements like the top navigation bar use translucent bg-slate-950/80 with a 1px border-b border-slate-800 to anchor content without creating simulated z-plane elevation.

dos: Do format all execution costs, query texts, schema definitions, and migration snippets in monospace font.
Do maintain a strict 1px border separation between adjacent dark slate containers.
Do preserve emerald exclusively for verified planner improvements and active successful recommendations.
Do test all layout changes against 375px mobile viewports to guarantee zero horizontal scroll.
Do display the honesty disclaimer alongside planner costs ("estimated cost on simulated 500,000 rows — not a benchmark").
donts: Don't add decorative box shadows, glossy skeuomorphic bevels, or colored ambient drop shadows.
Don't use generic red/green/yellow colors; use the calibrated slate-950/emerald-400/rose-400/amber-400 palette.
Don't render unverified cost numbers in emerald; unverified or non-improved outcomes must stay in amber or neutral tones.
Don't hide SQL errors or execution warnings behind generic error alerts; render PostgreSQL line numbers and AST gate rejection reasons verbatim.
Don't introduce multi-page navigation or modal traps; keep IndexDoctor as an immediate single-page diagnostic cockpit.
